articles.title: I am contemplating selling some of my bitcoin for gold, veteran trader Peter Brandt says
articles.snippet: Veteran trader Peter Brandt said gold is going to gain substantially on bitcoin.

articles.title: UN agency moves Stellar blockchain payment initiative beyond pilot stage
articles.snippet: The UN Development Programme said blockchain payment pilots in five countries cut costs, improved resilience and will now inform wider use across its humanitarian and development programs.

articles.title: Bitcoin price falls up to 4% on Strategy BTC sale as trader sees Summer 2022 repeat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin wiped out much of its latest gains thanks to a market reaction to Strategy's 3,600 BTC sell-off, but analysis eyed a potential buy announcement in the coming days.
